title: veronica austriaca f. praeterita
intro: Veronica austriaca f. praeterita, commonly known as Austrian Speedwell, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the family Plantaginaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Austrian Speedwell include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and diuretic, which may help alleviate symptoms of urinary tract infections and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
